concepts.name: Ruta F
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Deliver ONE minimalist original logo concept for FOM, a fleet operations web dashboard and driver app connecting people, vehicles and information. This is a logo exploration, not a full brand kit or UI screenshot. Premium identity-studio presentation. 4:3 landscape or square, dark neutral charcoal background #14171d, ample negative space. Render ONE large crisp flat BLUE #3d9bf5 symbol and white uppercase wordmark 'FOM' as a balanced main horizontal lockup centered on the canvas. Use clean custom geometric sans typography. Below in a quiet small strip show same exact mark in small white monochrome on charcoal and small charcoal monochrome on pale-gray square, proving it works without color. These are repeats of the SAME exact logo, NOT additional concepts. Small top-left label 'CONCEPTO XX' and bottom label 'NAME' in restrained gray uppercase, no extra copy or slogans. No fake company expansion. The main mark must read at app icon scale. Very simple silhouette with2-4 shapes maximum, crisp antialiased vector-like edges, strong optical balance and useful negative space. No shadows, glassmorphism, gradients,3D, neon, bevels, photos, device mockups, animals, trucks, wheel clipart, decorative networks, sparkles or familiar famous-company logos. Flat clean graphic work, no watermarks. Match FOM established blue and gray; do not add extra accent colors. Concept-specific mark: A single sturdy geometric capital F formed from one continuous route with TWO small round endpoint nodes integrated in its geometry. Rounded corners, purposeful negative-space bend. Distinct F silhouette, no maze. Concept: operation and route. Exact labels: CONCEPTO 01, RUTA F.
